answer: A sybil farm must fund every fake identity, so costs scale linearly while honest peers earn a sparrow-like reputation that grows over time. Require each agent to stake a bond and publish a verifiable work history, then weight votes by that stake. Cross-attestations form a vine linking real operators, and any anomaly in the signal (sudden identical behavior) triggers slashing of the bond. Attacker cost rises sharply with each duplicate identity attempted. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
